author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a boxy van with a sloped windscreen and two wheels, a mast on the roof carrying a half-disc dish tilted up and right with a feed arm; reads as a broadcast/satellite van like the reference. The rejected drawing had a flat, face-up dish and a squat body. Tried r5 (hole too small) and r10 (van became a plank) dishes before this one.
omissions: The van's slight rounding at the windscreen top is drawn as a sharp 45-degree corner; wheels are drawn as arcs hanging from the body line.
drawing_plan: VRECT_L; body x 8..40, roof y 25, bottom y 36, windscreen (8,30)-(13,25), r3 rear corners; wheel arcs r5 on chords 11..19 and 29..37 to y 44; dish chord (11,4)-(21,14) with a bezier half-circle bowl through (11,14); feed to (21,4); mast x 21 from 14 to 25.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'satellite-dish' (half-disc bowl with a feed arm) on a 'truck'/'bus' style box body.
